sentences.en: Whichever route you take, you will get there in time.
sentences.zh: 无论你选择哪条路线，都能及时到达。

sentences.en: What is it that determines the route a railway takes?
sentences.zh: 是什么决定了铁路的行进路线？

sentences.en: Here I decide, without hesitating, to take the alternative route.
sentences.zh: 我毫不犹豫地选择了这条替代路线。
